summary.intent: Debug and fix the skill analytics TUI showing empty skill data, then iteratively improve the UI with filtering, deduplication, and visual fixes.
summary.outcome: Fixed the root cause (skill name mismatch between insights.db signals and discovered skills), resolved multiple UI bugs (panic, tab misalignment, duplicate rows, stale suggestions), and added repo/personal scope filtering. All changes committed.

repo: skill_signals in insights.db uses LLM-extracted names (e.g. 'e2e:triage', 'cli-e2e-failure-fix') while skilldb discovery uses filesystem-derived names (e.g. 'e2e') — exact match was the cause of 0/5 signals matching
insights.db has 2,084 sessions and 7 skill_signals; skill-analytics.db had 0 skill_sessions before the fix
owner_name and owner_email columns exist in the sessions schema but are empty for all 2,084 sessions — per-user filtering is not yet viable
The installed binary at /opt/homebrew/bin/entire is separate from the worktree build; testing fixes requires building /tmp/entire-dev manually
skill-analytics.db cache invalidation uses a tip key; adding a 'v2:' version prefix forces repopulation without manual cache clearing
Skill discovery only scanned .claude/skills/, .claude/commands/, .gemini/ inside repo root — missed ~/.claude/ personal skills and plugin/superpowers skills
Skills are discovered for both claude-code and gemini-cli source agents, creating duplicate names in the picker before deduplication was added

code.finding: PopulateFromInsightsDB used exact string match skillMap[sig.SkillName] — any name mismatch silently skips the signal
renderSuccessRate panic: TotalFriction counts individual items (not sessions), so it can exceed TotalSessions, making barWidth - frictionFill negative in strings.Repeat
Tab underline misalignment: activeStart was calculated with len() (byte count) instead of lipgloss.Width() — '‹' and '›' are 3 bytes each but 1 display column
suggestions field on improveModel was never cleared in setData — caused stale suggestions from one skill to display on all other skills
ListSkills reads from DB which does not store the Scope field — scope must be carried in-memory from DiscoverSkills, not persisted to DB

workflow: When a local binary fix isn't reflected in the running app, the installed system binary may be shadowing it — always verify which binary is executing
go fmt can automatically replace fmt.Sprintf("%d", n) with strconv.Itoa(n), which then breaks compilation if strconv import is missing
Cache versioning (prefixing tip keys) is a clean way to force repopulation after schema/logic changes without requiring manual DB operations
For TUI column alignment with ANSI codes, lipgloss.Width() must be used instead of len() for any string that may contain color codes or multi-byte Unicode

friction: Multiple read retries on the same tool-results file for the PR diff — file wasn't being found or content was paginated
Binary not being rebuilt between test runs caused confusion about whether fixes were working ('all data is still empty')
go fmt silently changed strconv import requirement, causing a build failure after formatting
The f-key filter appeared to not work because the visual difference between active/inactive chips was too subtle — needed bracket markers to confirm toggle was functioning
Scope field lost in transit: set on DiscoveredSkill, never written to DB, then ListSkills returns rows without it — required reworking data flow to skip DB roundtrip for scope
open_items: owner_name and owner_email columns exist but are unpopulated — per-user 'My Usage' filter exists in UI but shows same data as 'All Users' until population pipeline is fixed
simplify and superpowers:writing-plans signals (2 of 5) still don't match any discovered skill — superpowers/plugin skills are intentionally excluded from discovery scope but represent real usage

The facet extraction prompt improvement (BuildPromptWithSkills) was added but the insights engine doesn't yet pass discovered skill names when calling Extract() — canonical name extraction is not yet active
Cross-repo memory loop enhancement (--scope=org flag using search API checkpoint domain) was identified as high-value but not implemented
QuerySkillSignalsForSkills now fetches ALL signals then filters in Go — could be inefficient at scale if skill_signals table grows large
